Steamed Chicken Rice.note: Light soy sauce = soy + gluten; sesame oil. Chicken-fat rice and chicken soup. No pork or alcohol: halal from ingredients (v3-v6 rule). Not spicy.

Roasted Chicken Rice.note: Soy sauce = soy + gluten; oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten. Honey. No sesame. Halal from ingredients. Not spicy.

Kids Chicken Rice.note: Same dressing as the steamed chicken: soy sauce and sesame oil. Not spicy.

Chicken Rice Balls.note: Rice cooked in chicken fat: not vegetarian. No allergens stated.

Plain Chicken Rice.note: Sounds plain but rice is cooked in chicken fat and chicken stock: not vegetarian. No allergens.

Half Steamed Chicken.note: Soy sauce and sesame oil dressing. Rice-free. Not spicy.

Quarter Roasted Chicken.note: Honey, soy sauce and oyster sauce glaze. Rice-free. Not spicy.

Char Siu Rice.note: Pork; soy sauce and maltose = gluten; red fermented beancurd = soy; rose wine: not halal anyway.

Siu Yuk Rice.note: Pork belly with five-spice and salt; yellow mustard on the side = mustard (condiment counts, rule m). No soy sauce, so gluten-free and soy-free.

Char Siu and Siu Yuk Rice.note: Char siu (soy, gluten) plus siu yuk with yellow mustard.

Roast Meat Platter.note: Char siu (soy, gluten), siu yuk, roasted chicken (oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten), yellow mustard. Pork: not halal.

Small Char Siu Plate.note: Char siu: soy, gluten; pork. Small portion, no rice.

Bean Sprouts in Oyster Sauce.note: Sounds vegetarian but oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten; soy sauce = soy + gluten. Halal. White pepper only, not spicy.

Kai Lan in Oyster Sauce.note: Oyster sauce and soy sauce. Not vegetarian.

Stir-fried Kai Lan with Ginger.note: Ginger, garlic, salt; stated no oyster sauce; vegan tag.

Braised Chicken Feet.note: Soy sauce, oyster sauce. A little dried chilli, mildly spicy.

Braised Tofu and Egg.note: Sounds vegetarian but braised in pork belly master stock: not vegetarian, not halal. Tofu and soy sauce; egg.

Steamed Silken Tofu.note: Tofu and light soy sauce = soy + gluten; sesame oil. Vegan tag.

Old Cucumber Soup.note: Pork ribs: not halal. Dried scallop = molluscs.

Lotus Root Soup.note: Pork ribs: not halal. Peanuts; dried octopus = molluscs.

Salted Vegetable Duck Soup.note: Duck, kiam chye, tomato, sour plum, ginger. Salted mustard greens are not the mustard allergen (v6 rule m). Halal from ingredients. Not spicy.

House Chilli Sauce.note: Sounds vegan but has chicken stock: not vegetarian. No belacan. Described spicy.

Ginger Dip.note: Hot chicken oil: not vegetarian. Described not spicy.

Herbal Jelly.note: Mesona and herbs (no turtle shell stated); honey on the side: vegetarian, not vegan.

Egg Tart.note: Wheat pastry made with lard: not vegetarian, not halal. Egg; evaporated milk.

Kopi O.note: No milk added, but beans roasted with butter = milk (v6 rule o): vegetarian, not vegan.
